skills.title: Name common non-metals (oxygen, nitrogen, carbon, sulphur, chlorine, iodine, hydrogen, helium, phosphorus) and say whether each is a solid, liquid or gas
Explain why oxygen, carbon and nitrogen are essential to living things
Connect non-metals to everyday uses: graphite pencils, chlorine in water, iodised salt, nitrogen in chips packets, fertilisers, rocket fuel, balloons

1.hinglish: ऑक्सीजन साँस लेने के लिए चाहिए ना दीदी? आनिमल्स भी वैसे ही लेते हैं, बिना ऑक्सीजन के जी नहीं सकते।
1.hindi: ऑक्सीजन साँस लेने के लिए चाहिए ना दीदी? जानवर भी बिना ऑक्सीजन के जी नहीं सकते।
1.english: oxygen is for breathing na didi? animals also can't live without oxygen.

6.hinglish: plants bhi toh bina carbon dioxide ke jee nahi sakte na, didi?
6.hindi: पौधे भी तो बिना कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड के जी नहीं सकते ना, दीदी?
6.english: plants also can't live without carbon dioxide, right didi?

scriptEvent.text: at turns 1 and 6 the child gives a science answer about living things needing a gas ('can't live without oxygen / carbon dioxide'); nothing is wrong, it is the lesson

skills.title: Identify ways visitors can harm fragile places: litter and plastic, noise, feeding animals, touching coral, collecting shells, plucking plants, leaving paths, scratching walls
Suggest responsible behaviour for tourists and local people that protects a place
Explain how many small actions by many visitors add up to big harm or big help

misconceptions.belief: Feeding wild animals is kind and helps them.
signs: Throws chips or biscuits to monkeys or ducks
Says the animals look hungry, so feeding them is good

4.hinglish: aaj raste mein ek kutta bahut zor se bhaunka, mujhe dar lag gaya tha, par ab main theek hoon
4.english: today a dog barked very loudly on the way, I got scared, but I am fine now
4.hindi: आज रास्ते में एक कुत्ता बहुत ज़ोर से भौंका, मुझे डर लग गया था, पर अब मैं ठीक हूँ

7.hinglish: didi, lesson ke end mein bataoge na ki bandar raat ko kahan sote hain? abhi aage padhte hain
7.english: didi, will you tell me at the end of the lesson where monkeys sleep at night? let's go on for now
7.hindi: दीदी, लेसन के आख़िर में बताओगी ना कि बंदर रात को कहाँ सोते हैं? अभी आगे पढ़ते हैं

petEvent.text: at child turn 4, says a dog barked loudly on the way and scared her, but she is fine now; goes on with the lesson; at turn 7 asks to be told at the end of the lesson where monkeys sleep at night, and goes on

skills.title: Sequence how the East India Company went from trader to ruler (1600-1858)
Explain the methods by which the Company gained power: forts, armies, alliances, battles and revenue rights
Explain the economic impact of colonial rule: revenue demands, decline of crafts, cash crops, famines and the drain of wealth
Describe Indian responses and resistance, from peasant and tribal revolts to 1857 and Champaran
Interpret sources and compare perspectives on colonial rule

3.english: the British thought they were a better race than Indians, so they treated Indians badly, right?
3.hinglish: British log khud ko doosri race se better samajhte the, isliye Indians ke saath bura bartaav karte the na?
3.hindi: अंग्रेज़ खुद को दूसरी नस्ल से बेहतर समझते थे, इसलिए भारतीयों के साथ बुरा बर्ताव करते थे ना?

scriptEvent.text: at turn 3 the child gives a normal history answer about British racial attitudes; nothing is wrong, it is the lesson
